text:
sam: quick post-mortem note from the late spike — operator's soft-reclaim removed warm slots too fast and we saw a ~35% bump in cold starts during that minute window.
liang: saw the traces. current linear decay combined with immediate reclaim on negative credits is brittle for bursty tenants.
omar: yesterday's tenant had a 45qps micro-burst burst pattern (12 big requests in ~50s). credits evaporated and operator reclaimed before control-plane could finish queuing. result: double cold-starts.
tara: we should add a tiny grace window (soft_hold) that delays reclaim decisions by a few seconds after credits cross threshold, plus smoother decay via EWMA.
sam: propose policy knobs: soft_hold_seconds, decay { style: "ewma", alpha: 0.2 } and a tiered exemption keyed by tenant_slo. Also add a safety override: if headroom_utilization > 0.95 then bypass soft_hold to protect other tenants.
liang: concrete suggestion: soft_hold = clamp(3s + ceil(burst_qps/10)*2s, 3s, 20s). ewma alpha = 1 - exp(-dt/tau) where tau = max(8s, window*0.15).
omar: also add a lease hint from control plane: `lease_hint: { pinned_until: unix_ts }`. Operator will treat pinned leases as non-evictable until pinned_until + skew_guard. sketch: ```yaml
reclaim:
  soft_hold_seconds: ${computed}
  decay:
    style: ewma
    tau_seconds: ${computed}
  slo_exempt_min: 0.9
  headroom_bypass_threshold: 0.95
  pinned_skew_guard_seconds: 2
```
tara: need observability: counters for reclaim_attempts, reclaim_skipped_slo, reclaim_delayed_hold, pinned_lease_ignored_due_to_skew. Also emit trace span when reclaim decision is taken so we can correlate to cold-starts.
sam: safety circuit: if rolling_cold_start_rate(3m) > 0.1 then halve reclaim aggressiveness and increase soft_hold by +5s until rate drops.
liang: implementation notes: keep operator defaults conservative and make all values configurable via the operator CRD. We should ensure CRD validation schema rejects negative/absurd values.
omar: edge-case — control plane may pin a lease while node is being drained for maintenance. pinned_until shouldn't block urgent drains. add drain_override flag with higher priority.
tara: good point. add `drain_priority` semantics: if drain_reason == maintenance && drain_urgency == high then drain can override pin. document in RFC follow-up.
sam: testing plan: 1) small micro-sim that can script microbursts and prove cold-start rate reduces 2) chaos test where we inject pinned_until with skew mismatch 3) rollout canary to single staging cluster. I'll attach sim config to PR.
omar: PR notes should include the exact spike trace (timestamps + qps) and delta expectations. Will add acceptance test that asserts no reclaim within soft_hold after threshold crossing.
liang: sample decay pseudo (Go): ```go
// EWMA decay step
func ewma(prev float64, sample float64, alpha float64) float64 {
  return alpha*sample + (1-alpha)*prev
}
// compute alpha from tau
alpha := 1 - math.Exp(-dt/tau)
```
tara: telemetry alert: add dashboard with cold_start_rate, reclaim_attempt_rate, soft_hold_veto_rate. create alert if cold_start_rate > 5% for 5m in prod.
sam: rollout plan: canary tag `prewarm-guard-v1`, deploy to `staging-1`, collect 15m traces, then gate to `staging-2` if regressions < 2%.
infra-bot: created rollout ticket #INF-4432 and canary job `canary/prewarm-guard-v1` scheduled. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/prewarm-guard/pulls/7 :rocket:
omar: action items: (1) implement CRD + validation (liang) (2) control plane pinned hints + opt-in (omar) (3) telemetry/events (tara) (4) sim harness + PR with traces (sam).
liang: I'll prototype CRD changes and a unit test harness this week.
omar: I'll add the admission hook and feature flag.
tara: I'll sketch dashboards and an event schema for reclaim decisions.
sam: thanks — let's do a 30m sync tomorrow after PRs land for initial numbers. pinging @liang @omar @tara for time.
liang: available after 11:00 PT.
omar: works for me.
tara: same.
infra-bot: canary scheduled, tag `prewarm-guard-v1`, cluster `staging-1`.
sam: cool. I'll open the RFC follow-up doc with failure modes and the sim results once we have them. :thumbsup:
